crossRefs.note: Gideon saw that he was Yahweh’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh! Because I have seen Yahweh’s angel face to…
Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and…
even Yahweh, the God of Armies; Yahweh is his name of renown!

people.name: Manoah
people.line: Father of Samson, from the tribe of Dan.

translations.web: But Yahweh’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was Yahweh’s angel.
translations.bsb: And when the angel of the LORD did not appear again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it had been the angel of the LORD.
translations.kjv: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
translations.asv: But the angel of Jehovah did no more appear to Manoah or to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was the angel of Jehovah.
